io.milvus.v2.client

Class MilvusClientV2

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.milvus.v2.client.MilvusClientV2

  • public class MilvusClientV2
extends Object
    Client for interacting with Milvus through the V2 API.

    Thread safety

    After client construction succeeds, RPC methods may be called concurrently on the same client while its connection and database state remain unchanged. Methods that change or close that state, including useDatabase(String), close(), close(long), and updatePassword(UpdatePasswordReq) when connection reset is requested, must be serialized with all other operations. Do not call these methods, or otherwise discard the client, while RPCs are in flight.

    Concurrent DML and DQL operations are supported. A DQL operation that overlaps a DML operation is not guaranteed to observe that write; wait for the DML operation to complete and use the appropriate consistency level when this ordering is required. DDL operations that change a database or collection's lifecycle or schema, such as drop, rename, truncate, or schema alteration, must not run concurrently with DML or DQL operations on the affected database or collection. Serialize these operations to avoid undefined ordering and unexpected results.

      • createDatabase

        public void createDatabase(CreateDatabaseReq request)
        Creates a database in Milvus.

        A database is a logical unit above collections for organizing data and supporting multi-tenancy. The request may carry properties such as database.replica.number to be applied to the new database.

        Parameters:
        request - the create database request

      • loadCollection

        public void loadCollection(LoadCollectionReq request)
        Loads a collection into memory.

        Loading is a prerequisite for similarity searches and queries. The index files and raw data of all fields are loaded into memory; entities inserted afterwards are indexed and loaded automatically.

        Parameters:
